purpose: Teach: トレーダー/地蔵/グランプリ/怪獣/三昧/言うまでもなく/このごろ/スキン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの友人にトレーダーの方がいらっしゃるのよ
lines.en: Sho, you know your father has a friend who's a trader.
lines.style: Conversational, matter-of-fact. Opening with his name to get his attention. Calm, practical tone — the kind of ordinary information a mother mentions in passing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんちの地蔵にお祈りしたよ
lines.en: Mom, I prayed at Grandma's stone statue.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his voice. Not boasting — just sharing something he did that felt important. Gentle clarity, no need to convince anyone.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが映画のグランプリ受賞作を勧めてくださったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father recommended a film — it won the Grand Prix.
lines.style: Slightly warmer now. The information flows naturally, like she's thinking out loud. Her tone says: this is nice, isn't it? No urgency. Reflective.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、怪獣ヒーローのおもちゃ集めてるよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm collecting monster hero toys.
lines.style: Open, eager. A boy wanting to share what he cares about. Not seeking permission, just letting her know. Small, genuine enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お休みの日はゲーム三昧にならないでね
lines.en: Sho, don't spend your days off lost in games, all right?
lines.style: Gentle firmness. Not a lecture — a quiet rule stated with love. The tone says she cares enough to set the boundary. Warm but clear.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんは言うまでもなく頑張ってらっしゃるよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad works hard without even being asked.
lines.style: Soft observation. No performance — just noticing something true about his father. The tenderness is in the recognition, not forced. Quiet, certain.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、このごろお祖母ちゃんが心配なの
lines.en: Sho, I'm worried about Grandma lately.
lines.style: Quieter now. The weight of the concern comes through, but she doesn't dramatize it. Speaking to him as someone she trusts. Vulnerability without asking for help.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お肌スキンケア、お父さんと一緒にするよ
lines.en: Mom, I do my skincare with Dad now.
lines.style: Warmth and closeness in the voice. He's sharing a small routine that means something. Not trying to fix her worry, just offering his own small steady thing. Tender and natural.
